request:
镜头 s08：纪录片细节特写镜头，时长 7 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
风格模式：固定风格（style preset sp01-lab50s）。锁定外观 / Locked look（detailed_description 第一行必须照此书写，并逐字包含 ['Super 16', 'Vision3 500T']）：Locked look "2050s institute film archive" (style preset sp01-lab50s): an Arriflex 416 Super 16 camera; Kodak Vision3 500T 7219 pushed one stop; a 12-120mm documentary zoom at f/2.8; filter none; grade: muted, desaturated, a green-cyan fluorescent cast with one warm practical; light: cold fluorescent tubes plus one warm desk lamp, deep shadows; texture: lively Super 16 grain, slightly soft resolution; the institute's own observational record, watching people work from across the room.
该类型的纪录片默认机位：documentary insert close-up grabbed handheld, focus breathing
导演意图（自然语言）：微距特写，手持，焦点轻微呼吸。台灯下，一双手把一块回收的电路板装进一只凹痕累累的旧饼干铁盒里，这是一台自制的网络节点；拧上天线，盒子上的小灯第一次亮了。环境声：螺丝刀的咔哒声、机房嗡鸣。
情绪：focused, intimate, hopeful
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：macro close-up, handheld with focus breathing, one slow push in
景深与虚实：Very shallow depth of field: the solder point and LED crisp, the bench clutter melting into blur.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Insert close-up on the cluttered lab bench under a desk lamp: Song's hands fit a small green circuit board into an old dented biscuit tin that serves as the case of a homemade network router, with a short Wi-Fi style antenna on top; a fine-tipped soldering iron rests beside it and the router's first tiny status light glows. Blocking lock: the dented tin box sits at frame centre on the bench, Song's hands enter from frame left, the desk lamp glows at the top right.
Picture 2: Song's prototype node (the dented tin box, still without a sticker) (prop reference; role: prop reference). A handmade prototype network node: an old dented steel tin box with a plain scratched olive-grey lid, a salvaged circuit board, a small heat sink, three tiny LEDs and a short screw-on antenna, on a cluttered lab workbench under a desk lamp. No sticker on the lid.
Picture 3: Engineer Song (Song Qi, 33 in 2048, systems engineer on the 550 quantum-computer project) (character reference; role: the protagonist). A 33-year-old Chinese man, systems engineer on a national quantum-computer project. Slim, medium height, short neat black hair with a side parting, clean-shaven, a small mole under his right eye, warm attentive eyes with faint laugh lines, thin round steel-rimmed glasses. Light-grey knitted cardigan over a pale blue collared work shirt, a blank white ID card on a dark lanyard, a cheap black digital wristwatch on his left wrist.
本镜头没有台词。
现场环境声：small screwdriver clicks, a faint electronic tick, low lab hum
参考词汇（检索所得，只借用术语与思路，不要整段照抄，不得改变锁定外观）：
[ours/cam-insert] 机位：细节特写插入
[rules/size/macro-detail] size
[rules/size/hands-insert] size
[ours/emo-hope-small] 情绪：微小的希望

detailed_description:
16:9 horizontal, single clip 7.0s, 24fps, Locked look "2050s institute film archive" (style preset sp01-lab50s): an Arriflex 416 Super 16 camera; Kodak Vision3 500T 7219 pushed one stop; a 12-120mm documentary zoom at f/2.8; filter none; grade: muted, desaturated, a green-cyan fluorescent cast with one warm practical; light: cold fluorescent tubes plus one warm desk lamp, deep shadows; texture: lively Super 16 grain, slightly soft resolution; the institute's own observational record, watching people work from across the room; no hard subtitles, no burned-in captions, no on-screen text, no logo, watermark or platform bugs.
[Shot 1] At 0.0s, macro close-up, handheld camera with a small breathing sway and one very slow push in from macro close-up on the tin box to a tighter macro detail on the antenna base and the status light, focus breathing softly on the key detail as the frame drifts a few centimetres closer; pacing: natural speed, a single continuous take with no cut. The dented tin box sits at frame centre on the bench, Song's hands enter from frame left, the desk lamp glows at the top right, the cluttered background dissolved into blur behind. Start: both hands come in from frame left, the right index finger easing the salvaged green circuit board down into the open tin, the left thumb holding the lid edge steady, a small screwdriver pinched between two fingers. Middle: the board settles with a soft click and the hands press its corners level, then the right hand lifts the short screw-on antenna, finds the thread and turns it down, the wrist turning three or four times, the black digital wristwatch sliding a little on the forearm while the cardigan cuff bunches at the wrist. End: the fingers leave the antenna, the hand pauses a few centimetres above the box, and the first tiny status light comes on as a crisp bright point on the board, steady, not blinking; the fingers curl slightly and begin to withdraw toward frame left as the focus holds on the glowing LED. Mood: focused, intimate, hopeful. Blur: the solder point, the antenna thread and the lit LED crisp, the bench clutter, the soldering iron and the far wall melting into soft green-cyan blur, the warm lamp pool bleeding into the top-right corner. No character speaks any line in this shot; any human voices are indistinct, unintelligible Mandarin Chinese walla only. Hold the last frame.
